# Avali
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to major gameplay changes![/color]
Avali are similar in appearance to bipedal bird-raptors, with large wings on their arms, long tails, and four rabbit-like ears. Thier biology is ammonia-based, and thus ideal for extremely cold temperatures. Additionally, they are capable of short flights in low gravity environments.
## Racial Features
- They are [color=#ffa500]obligate carnivores[/color] and are thus unable to eat any non-meat based foods. - They get hungry [color=#ffa500]100% faster[/color]. - Their blood is ammonia-based and has a distinct purple color, it is metabolised from copper and it has a [color=#ffa500]severe allergic reaction to iron[/color]. - They requires a special chemical, Amoxla, to heal airloss damage. - Regular [color=#ffa500]airloss chemicals are extremely deadly[/color] to them. - Their wings give them [color=#1e90ff]60% more acceleration in 0 gravity[/color]. - They are quick and nimble, [color=#1e90ff]running 6% faster[/color]. - They are slightly more frail, [color=#ffa500]falling into crit at 90 damage and dying at 180 damage[/color]. - They receive [color=#ffa500]20% more heat damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]20% less cold damage[/color]. - They posses [color=#ffbc48]nanite Technology![/color] Can encase themselves in a [color=#ffbc48]Nanite Shell[/color] to heal most common types of damage. - They can talk over [color=#ffbc48]The Nexus with :x.[/color]. - Thanks to their claws they deal [color=red]6.25[/color] slash damage with their unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is -10 degrees Celcius and they [color=#1e90ff]can withstand temperatures between -50 and 40 degrees Celcius[/color].
## Weapon Knockback Avali are incredibly lightweight, and thus they have difficulty using weapons that are any bigger than pistols or SMGs. Shooting any other weapon will cause them to take stamina damage and get pushed back. Rocket launchers, since they are recoil-less, will actually [color=red]pull Avali forward with the rocket[/color] for a short distance. Stamina resistance will help mitigate some of the effects of knockback, but will never completely negate it.
## Scratch The Avali language, known as Scratch, is composed of a series of screeches, caws and throat sounds. It is often described as fast paced and sharp, easily pronounceable by most species with some practice. In addition, Avali share this language with Resomi.
## Age and Names Avali are a long lived species, reaching adulthood around 18 years of age and being capable of living for 300 years. Their names are given to them upon hatching, often consisting of a first name, followed by a pack name.
